description: For all propositional formulas A and B, the implication from the conjunction of A and the implication from A to B into B is a tautology.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.modusPonens_tautology.{u} {α : Type u} (A B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Tautology ((A.conj (A.impl B)).impl B)
